name: @herta/gui
description: Herta — the self that uses the agent
author: PersonaCLI

scripts.dist: node scripts/check-voice-payload.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check && npx electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/check-voice-payload.mjs && electron-vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check && npx electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:release: node scripts/check-voice-payload.mjs && node scripts/check-signing-env.mjs win && electron-vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check && npx electron-builder --win -c.win.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.dist:release:mac: node scripts/check-voice-payload.mjs && node scripts/check-signing-env.mjs mac && electron-vite build && node scripts/third-party-notices.mjs --check && npx electron-builder --mac -c.mac.hardenedRuntime=true -c.mac.notarize=true
